sample_unit: patients (first ADHD-related visit notes; 122 stratified notes manually annotated for performance)

links.outcome: LLM accuracy at identifying PTBM recommendations in local EHR notes versus expert chart review
links.effect: Claude-3.5 sensitivity 0.89, PPV 0.95, F1 0.92; LLaMA3.3-70B sensitivity 0.91, PPV 0.89, F1 0.90; GPT-4o sensitivity 0.82, PPV 0.97, F1 0.89.
links.quote: All three models demonstrated high performance compared to expert chart review.

unlisted_practices: Ranking LLM-generated rationales for explainability using the QUEST framework
Enriching manual annotation with all cases of model disagreement across three LLMs

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLMs (Claude-3.5, GPT-4o, LLaMA-3.3) for extracting quality-of-care recommendations from pediatric EHR notes and assesses their explainability, but it does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard comparison.
